page_topic_one_liner: Blog creation from zero — tech stack (WordPress/SSG), editorial workflow, SEO template config, content clusters, and promotion
differentiator_vs_generic: This is blog launch + SEO foundation guide, NOT social media growth hacks. Hero must show blog CMS editor with Article schema + sitemap/GSC submission flow — NOT an LLM writing assistant chat as hero.
visual_anchors: HERO (~55% canvas): Blog post editor mockup — title field, H1/H2 outline sidebar, featured image placeholder, publish button — overlapped with XML sitemap submit card and Search Console property verification checkmark (generic UI, no WordPress logo)
Secondary: topic cluster diagram — one pillar node center with 4 spoke article nodes connected by internal link arrows
Tertiary: Core Web Vitals pass strip (LCP/INP/CLS gauge silhouettes) hinting at SSG performance ceiling
anti_patterns: AI writing assistant prompt box dominating canvas
Social media follower counter or viral post imagery unrelated to blog SEO
